arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Calendar years 1969-1971 data (in millions)
sales_plus_accrued_discount_1969 = 366
redemptions_1969 = 76

sales_plus_accrued_discount_1970 = 191
redemptions_1970 = 154

sales_plus_accrued_discount_1971 = 27
redemptions_1971 = 124

# Calculate totals
total_sales_with_accrued_discount = sales_plus_accrued_discount_1969 + sales_plus_accrued_discount_1970 + sales_plus_accrued_discount_1971
total_redemptions = redemptions_1969 + redemptions_1970 + redemptions_1971

print(f"Total sales with accrued discount (1969-1971): {total_sales_with_accrued_discount}")
print(f"Total redemptions (1969-1971): {total_redemptions}")

ratio = total_redemptions / total_sales_with_accrued_discount
print(f"Ratio: {ratio}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(ratio, 2)}")
EOF
